name: ChatGPT
quote: In less than 200 days after launch, ChatGPT Ads has reached $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate.
basis: company-announced annualized run-rate for the ChatGPT Ads segment ONLY, not total OpenAI/ChatGPT revenue (Bloomberg reported >$40B total on 2026-08-13, paywalled, unverified)

name: HeyGen
quote: HeyGen, the identity-first AI video platform, today announced it has surpassed $200 million in annual recurring revenue, doubling in eight months.
basis: company-blog announcement by CEO Joshua Xu, self-reported ARR

name: Genspark
quote: Genspark said it added $150 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) in the first three months of 2026, on top of the $100 million ARR it generated since launching in April 2025.
basis: company-stated to Reuters at Series B extension: $100M (Apr-Dec 2025) + $150M (Q1 2026) = $250M cumulative run-rate

name: Grok
quote: xAI's estimated annual recurring revenue is approximately $500 million against a burn rate near $1 billion per month per Bloomberg.
basis: third-party estimate (newsletter citing Bloomberg, dated 2026-03-24, updated 2026-07-17); no company disclosure - xAI is now a SpaceX subsidiary

name: Character.AI
quote: Sacra estimates that Character.AI hit $30 million in annualized revenue in July 2025. The company projects that it will hit $50 million at the end of 2025.
basis: third-party Sacra estimate (self-labeled); primary revenue is the $9.99/mo c.ai+ subscription; Business of Apps separately estimates $50M CY2025 revenue

name: Descript
quote: Sacra estimates that Descript hit $55M in annual recurring revenue (ARR) in late 2024, representing 75% year-over-year growth.
basis: third-party Sacra estimate (self-labeled); no company-disclosed revenue figure found

name: Cluely
quote: here's what we were doing at the time: > consumer arr 2.7m, run rate 3.8m > enterprise arr 2.5m, run rate 2.5m
basis: founder-posted Stripe figures (June 2025) in his retraction: $2.7M consumer + $2.5M enterprise ARR = $5.2M; the earlier $7M ARR claim was admitted fabricated

name: RizzGPT
quote: They've co-founded three successful apps: RizzGPT, Umax, and Cal AI, collectively generating an impressive $15.4 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR).
basis: DERIVED: Forbes' $15.4M ARR for the RizzGPT+Umax+Cal AI portfolio minus Cal AI's stated $8M ARR (same article) = ~$7.4M combined for RizzGPT+Umax; per-app split never disclosed - do not double-count with a Umax row

name: Chai
quote: surpassed its 2025 revenue target two months ahead of schedule, reaching $48 million by the end of October. The company now projects over $50 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) by year-end
basis: company PR Newswire release (republished by Yahoo Finance); $48M is revenue through Oct 2025, >$50M ARR is the company year-end projection

name: Tolan
quote: Four months later, its ARR has reached $12 million, with over 3 million downloads. That attracted Tolan a $20 million Series A round led by Khosla Ventures.
basis: third-party Substack analysis; corroborated by ARR Club milestone page dated 2025-07-04 ($12M, +780%)

name: Plaud
quote: It also said that its subscription business has reached more than $100 million in annualized revenue run rate.
basis: company-stated software/subscription ARR only, told to TechCrunch; excludes hardware sales

name: Turbo AI
quote: Five million users. Eight-figure annual recurring revenue. Twenty thousand new users joining daily.
basis: founder-stated eight-figure ARR to TechCrunch; no exact number, $10M recorded as the floor

name: Umax
quote: Dhawan previously built UMax, an advice app that promised to make people more attractive and reached No. 1 on the App Store with 20 million users and $6 million in annual revenue.
basis: founder-stated to TechCrunch; supersedes the derived RizzGPT+Umax split in the RizzGPT basis note

name: MiniMax
quote: The Hong Kong-listed AI firm annual recurring revenue exceeded $150 million as of February 2026, management revealed during the earnings call.
basis: company-disclosed ARR at first post-IPO earnings (HK-listed); company-wide figure - consumer products (Hailuo + Talkie) were $53.1M of 2025 revenue

name: Otter.ai
quote: In March 2025, Otter.ai surpassed $100 million in annual recurring revenue.
basis: company-blog press release dated 2025-12-22 announcing the March 2025 milestone; GetLatka independently lists $100M for 2025

name: Duolingo
quote: We closed 2025 with strong momentum, surpassing 50 million daily active users and generating more than $1 billion in bookings for the first time, said Luis von Ahn, Co-Founder and CEO of Duolingo.
basis: FY2025 BOOKINGS (not ARR) from official Q4/FY2025 earnings release, Feb 26 2026

name: PolyBuzz
quote: Monthly Revenue $2.0M / Yearly Revenue $24.0M / Per Download $2.86
basis: third-party app-intelligence estimate (AppRank, Aug 2026); #30 in top-grossing Entertainment

name: Linky
quote: Monthly Revenue $90.0K / Yearly Revenue $1.1M / Per Download $1.50
basis: third-party AppRank estimate (Aug 2026); Android revenue may not be fully captured

name: Grammarly
quote: In 2025, Grammarly revenue reached $700M. The company previously reported $700M in 2024.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate (self-labeled); no company-disclosed figure found - upgrades the charted-but-claim-less entry

name: Picsart
quote: In 2024, PicsArt revenue reached $750M. The company previously reported $259M in 2020.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate; treat as upper bound - only the 2021 $1.5B Series C valuation is company-public

name: FaceApp
quote: In 2022, FaceApp revenue reached $80M. The company previously reported $50M in 2021.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate for 2022; no newer figure - app still #6 in top-grossing Photo & Video

name: Lightricks
quote: In 2024, Lightricks revenue reached $80.7M.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate; covers Facetune #5, Videoleap and Photoleap in top-grossing Photo & Video

name: Brainly
quote: In 2025, Brainly revenue reached $75M. The company previously reported $59.6M in 2024.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate (self-labeled Estimated); strongest figure for the homework-AI cluster

name: Lensa AI
quote: In 2024, Prisma Labs revenue reached $20.2M. The company previously reported $16.2M in 2023.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate (self-labeled Est.); does not reflect the Dec-2022 viral spike; still #91 top-grossing Photo & Video

name: Replika
quote: In 2026, Replika revenue reached $4.8M. The company previously reported $14M in 2024.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimates CONFLICT with each other ($14M 2024 / $4.8M 2026) and with other estimates (~$35M); $14M kept as last pre-decline estimate - flagged, unreliable

name: Fireflies.ai
quote: In 2024, Fireflies.ai revenue reached $10.9M. The company previously reported $5.8M in 2023.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate (self-labeled Estimated); $1B valuation 2025 but no newer revenue disclosure

name: Read AI
quote: In 2024, Read.ai revenue reached $6.9M.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate; no company disclosure found

name: Speechify
quote: 2025 Revenue $17.6M
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate; founder claims profitability in press but no ARR figure - GetLatka is the only dated revenue claim

name: Boomy
quote: In 2025, Boomy revenue reached $1.4M.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate; the only dated consumer-AI-music claim besides Suno

name: SnapCalorie
quote: In 2024, SnapCalorie revenue reached $1M.
basis: third-party GetLatka estimate (YC company, 7 employees); floor-value row
